scope: 112 fixed native WebUI API method/path pairs. This manifest records source implementation and exact dependencies; metadata alone is not execution or runtime acceptance.

webuiSession.minimumContract: 凭据只由现有WebUI session/secret store owner保管。公开结果返回session handle/认证状态。passkey challenge与rpId/origin沿真实浏览器WebAuthn会话。
webuiSession.permission: Existing native WebUI credential-store authority. Passkey challenge/response uses the original interactive origin/rpId.

loginLifecycle.purpose: QQ登录、自动登录偏好及NapCat进程重启
loginLifecycle.minimumContract: 复用NapCat login action与正式启动/重启owner，保Route/instance/QQ身份及原operation回执。登录密码摘要/验证码作为受保护输入。
loginLifecycle.permission: Existing authenticated connection and exact instance lifecycle/login owner. Original request and admission decisions remain authoritative.

deviceIdentity.purpose: Windows GUID与Linux MAC/machine-id及定向备份恢复
deviceIdentity.minimumContract: 按实际平台的device identity owner操作，显式backupId、目标身份与受保护读取结果。变更前备份、变更后回读，不自动重置已配置身份。
deviceIdentity.permission: Existing host-device identity/configuration authority, platform match and exact backup ownership.

typedMetadata.purpose: 版本、hash、平台、主题读取、消息端诊断、日志与插件只读目录
typedMetadata.minimumContract: 关闭参数与结果字段、日志脱敏、有界读取；SSE使用具名订阅handle并在取消/断开时释放。图标/页面通过已拥有资源handle与MIME返回。
typedMetadata.permission: Existing authenticated connection and exact Route/instance/QQ binding. Results follow a bounded reviewed DTO or content summary.

endpointConfig.minimumContract: 原配置owner读取/补丁/CAS写入。secret refs与普通字段分离，TLS私钥保存在secret owner，只公开存在/指纹/状态。
endpointConfig.permission: Existing configuration-edit and secret-store authority for this exact instance. Secret material uses protected references.

ownedFiles.purpose: 文件和目录、字体资源及配置归档导入导出
ownedFiles.minimumContract: 复用正式文件owner的授权路径/文件handle，解析绝对路径和链接归属。二进制流存受保护artifact，不把内容或宿主路径当通用JSON。批量变化保逐项原结果。
ownedFiles.permission: Existing host-file authority for the selected owned artifact/scope and operation. Binary/config archives use protected handles.

diagnosticRuntime.purpose: 终端与调试adapter创建/关闭/调用
diagnosticRuntime.minimumContract: 终端沿已有computer/terminal权限、job/seq与连接owner。Debug call映射已注册typed OneBot能力并复用发送/文件/敏感结果owner，adapter token只保内部。
diagnosticRuntime.permission: Existing terminal/job or registered action authority. Native pty input, sequence and adapter lifetime belong to that owner.

pluginManagement.purpose: NapCat插件配置、配置控制器、启停、卸载、注册、商店安装
pluginManagement.minimumContract: 按真实NapCat插件ID/来源/包digest与用户插件权限操作。每插件配置schema/secret metadata归插件owner。安装与启停有原operation/CAS或幂等回执。
pluginManagement.permission: Existing native plugin lifecycle/configuration authority for the exact plugin ID, selected package and declared plugin hooks.

releaseMirrors.purpose: 上游发行目录、镜像设置/探测与NapCat更新
releaseMirrors.minimumContract: 镜像URL与认证由已配置资源owner解析。网络探测有超时/有界结果。更新复用维护owner的不可变候选、任务排空、回退和实际版本回读。
releaseMirrors.permission: Existing configured mirror/resource and maintenance lifecycle authority. Update progress, digest and rollback belong to the original operation.

networkFetch.minimumContract: 归已有网络请求权限与目标资源owner，固定用户目标、协议、大小/超时和结果类型。当前NapCat本身只检查URL是字符串。
networkFetch.permission: Existing network-target/resource authority and explicit request/result contract.
